name: Tolka Sport Runlite
description: A stripped-down running shoe designed for high mileage on a low budget. Single-piece foam midsole, thin knit upper, minimal branding. Nothing fancy, nothing broken. Tier 2 runners who log serious distance trust these because they're predictable.
functionality: Reflective heel strip for low-light visibility. Passive only.
what_it_says: You run because you need to, not because it's a lifestyle. You know what your feet want.
worn_by: people who run before their shift
story_hooks: A courier was wearing these when they disappeared with a package that apparently didn't exist.
Tolka sponsors a free community running club on the Tier 2 greenway. The shoes are the membership fee.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek, minimalist running shoe with a low-profile silhouette. Narrow heel counter, streamlined toe box. Appears engineered rather than styled—form follows function. The shoe reads as purposeful and no-nonsense, favored by courier runners and distance athletes in the working-tier GLMZ.
physical_description.fit: Snug through the midfoot and heel, with responsive toe spring. Designed for sustained running rather than casual wear—compression-like in how it holds the foot during movement.
physical_description.primary_material: Thin, breathable knit upper in a technical mesh blend; single-piece expanded foam midsole (likely recycled polymer composite); minimal rubber outsole on high-wear zones only.
physical_description.texture: Upper is smooth and slightly stretchy with fine ribbing; midsole has a slightly dimpled, cushioned feel with subtle flex grooves molded into the foam.
physical_description.color_scheme: Neutral monochrome palette—charcoal gray, matte black, or slate. Single contrasting accent stripe (electric blue or safety orange) along the midfoot. No gradient, no pattern. Utilitarian.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit lacing with flat synthetic cord; no toggle or lock. Quick-release design for fast donning.
distinctive_features: Exposed foam midsole edges with no upper trim—shows material honestly
Minimal branding: small Tolka wordmark on heel only, no swoosh or logo bloat
Grooved flex channels running the length of the midsole for natural gait
Recycled content stamp (small Φ-symbol marking) on tongue indicating sub-Tier-2 manufacturing cost optimization
Wear patterns visible on display units: scuff marks on toe, slight compression creasing on medial arch
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 functional—affordable, reliable, mass-produced. Signals working-class commitment to distance running without corporate sponsorship.
physical_description.cultural_context: Courier runners, underground athletes, delivery-network workers, and serious hobbyists in the GLMZ who log 50+ km weekly. Wearing Tolka Runlites says: 'I value efficiency over status. My body is my asset.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Breaks in quickly but lasts 800-1200 km. Typically seen with road salt residue, minor heel drag, and compressed foam in high-mileage pairs. Display pairs are clean but show intentional scuff to prove durability.

image_prompt: Close-up fashion photograph of Tolka Sport Runlite running shoes displayed on sleek dark mannequin legs or worn by a lean courier-type model in motion. Moody neon-lit warehouse backdrop with rain-slick concrete. Shallow depth of field on shoe details—focus on midsole foam texture and the minimalist upper. Cool blue and amber accent lighting.
